objective: Determine whether fixed correct-state memory strength can recover scene recall while retaining the false-positive reduction of the full-strength accepted memory decoder.
claim_boundary: This post-validation TRAIN-derived development study may nominate one fixed strength for fresh replication. It cannot alter the accepted publisher-validation decoder or create a new native benchmark claim.

intervention.definition: For every wrapped layer, set memory_fusion_residual_scale to the candidate value before write-then-read generation. For attention_output placement this multiplies the fused memory correction before adding it to the frozen attention output.
intervention.full_strength_generation: Reuse signed correct-state memory outputs from natural_memory_native_routed_benchmark_v1_r2.

data_scope.partition_rule: Compute SHA-256('rwkv-ms-scale-v1:' + target row SHA-256); holdout iff the unsigned integer from the first eight hex characters modulo five equals zero, otherwise fit.

two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_one: Generate all four intermediate strengths for fit targets only. Holdout targets are forbidden.
two_phase_stopping_rule.selection_candidates: The four generated intermediate strengths plus the reused full-strength 1.0 baseline.
two_phase_stopping_rule.selection_ordering: micro-F1 descending, precision descending, recall descending, strength ascending
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two_authorization: Only if every phase-one gate passes, write a signed selection.json naming exactly one intermediate strength and implementation hashes before generating holdout targets.
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two: Generate only the signed selected strength for the 73 holdout targets, exactly once.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push phase one and any authorized phase two whether pass or fail. Never read publisher-validation predictions, publisher test, or Hard32. Never generate holdout strengths before selection.json is signed and pushed.
